Calc shape palette (discrete)

Source: R/calc.R
calc_shape_pal.Rd

Shape palette based on the shapes used in LibreOffice Calc.

Usage

calc_shape_pal()

See also

Other shapes calc: scale_shape_calc()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  library("ggplot2")
  show_shapes(calc_shape_pal()(13))
} # }
